old_description: Francis Cable Systems has been producing UL Listed armored cable products since 1995.
about:
Francis Cable Systems operates from Lakewood, New Jersey. The privately held company was formed in 1978 and began producing UL Listed armored cable products in 1995. No founders are named in the available information.

The company manufactures a full line of UL Listed armored cable products and provides custom armoring, twisting, cabling, and wire marking services using what it describes as state-of-the-art production lines. Specific facility size, headcount, annual volumes, or part-number counts are not disclosed.

The firm serves customers across the Northeast, ranging from large-scale projects to small companies that need unique custom armoring concepts delivered on schedule and at competitive cost. No specific industry verticals are named in the source material.

Management emphasizes high-quality output and the ability to meet custom armoring requirements in a timely, cost-effective manner as the reasons the business was established and what sets it apart in a competitive marketplace.
